subject: english
question:
**Some parts of one or more sentences have been jumbled up, and labelled A, B, C and D. Select the option that gives the correct sequence in which these parts can be rearranged to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence. **

They walked down the hall of

A. rocked them to sleep and played songs for them

B. had cost them seventy-five

C. thousand rupees. This house clothed and fed them

D. their soundproofed home, which
solution:
Here the correct answer is** DBCA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence is: **DBCA**.
 
• The sentence can be arranged as follows:
 
 
• They walked down the hall of
 
• **D**. their soundproofed home, which
 
• **B**. had cost them seventy-five 
 
• **C**. thousand rupees. This house clothed and fed them
 
• **A**. rocked them to sleep and played songs for them
 
 
 
• This sequence forms a coherent sentence that describes the experience of walking down the hall of their soundproofed home.
 
• It starts with the mention of their soundproofed home** (D),** followed by the information about the cost of the house **(B).**
 
• Then, it continues by mentioning how the house provided for their basic needs** (C).**
 
• Finally, it concludes the sentence by mentioning the actions of rocking them to sleep and playing songs for them **(A).**
